title: FoAViS: Analyzing Learned Fixation Strategies in a Foveated Active Vision System
summary: FoAViS learns task-directed fixations; across the reported visual tasks, location logits drop immediately after fixation and recover later, yielding a model-level revisit-suppression pattern. This does not establish a human visual mechanism.
ai_technology: FoAViS uses a jointly trained fixation policy to choose image glimpses for a foveated neural vision model.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: four image classification/segmentation benchmarks, learned versus random/heuristic policies and analysis of fixation logits across steps
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study; author affiliation is not stated in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: FoAViS uses a jointly trained fixation policy to choose image glimpses for a foveated neural vision model.
